items.question: When do you meet?
items.answer: We typically meet every Wednesday from 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM in MSCS 445, check the schedule on our home page for any changes!

items.question: Do I need experience to join?
items.answer: No experience needed! We welcome everyone from beginners to experienced developers.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: Just bring yourself and a laptop if you have one. We'll provide the rest!

items.question: How do I sign up for the game jam?
items.answer: Click the registration banner or hyperlink at the top of the home page.
